definitions.ask: Should the two new workflow-YAML guards join the contract set, raising its entry cap from 75 to 77?
definitions.why: .github edits seed no tests, and every other workflow-YAML guard is already admitted

choices.label: Cap becomes 77; workflow edits to install-smoke and testpypi-drill keep scoped check coverage
Cap stays 75; those two workflows lose scoped coverage and rely on CI's exhaustive lane
